record.context_brief: Sizes and moduli dimensions of big actions
record.original_question: For actions (C, G) satisfying condition (N), describe the possible values of |G|/g_C^2 and, for each such value, bound the dimension of the corresponding subvariety of M_g parametrizing curves with that kind of big p-group action.

evidence.quote: Question 6.12 Describe the set of possible values of |G|/g_C^2 and for each value give a bound on the dimension of the subvariety in M_g corresponding to curves C with such a big action.

artifact.category_tag: Big actions of p-groups on curves
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p>0$, and let $C$ be a smooth, projective, geometrically connected curve over $k$ of genus $g_C \ge 2$. Let $G \subseteq \mathrm{Aut}_k(C)$ be a finite $p$-subgroup. The pair $(C,G)$ is called a big action if $G$ is non-trivial and the inequality \[ \frac{|G|}{g_C} \;>\; \frac{2p}{p-1} \] holds. For a big action $(C,G)$, fix a point $\infty \in C$ such that $G$ is contained in the wild inertia at $\infty$ (this point is unique), and let $G_i$ ($i \ge 0$) denote the lower ramification filtration of $G$ at $\infty$.

Consider big actions $(C,G)$ satisfying the additional condition that the second ramification group $G_2$ is contained in the center $Z(G)$ of $G$ and that the quotient $G/G_2$ is abelian (this is the condition (N)). 

(a) Determine the set $\mathcal{V} \subseteq \mathbb{Q}_{>0}$ of all values that can occur as $|G|/g_C^{\,2}$ for such pairs $(C,G)$ with $g_C \ge 2$.

(b) For each value $v \in \mathcal{V}$, give an upper bound on the dimension of the locally closed subvariety of the moduli space $\mathcal{M}_{g}$ (over $k$) parametrizing isomorphism classes of curves $C$ of genus $g = g_C$ admitting a big action $(C,G)$ satisfying condition (N) with $|G|/g_C^{\,2} = v$.
artifact.status_search_result: The classification of big actions and the precise set of values of $|G|/g_C^2$ together with sharp dimension bounds on the corresponding loci in $\mathcal{M}_g$ remains a research question. Subsequent works (e.g., Rocher's thesis and later papers on big actions with non-abelian derived subgroup) extend the classification but do not provide a complete answer to both parts; the question appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Rocher Thèse - Big actions
status_evidence.snippet: Extends the classification of big actions initiated by Lehr and Matignon, including big actions with cyclic G_2 and examples with G_2 abelian of exponent > p.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work extends but does not fully resolve the classification of big actions and corresponding moduli loci.

status_evidence.title: Big Actions with non abelian derived subgroup
status_evidence.snippet: Further investigation of big actions, indicating ongoing research on the structure and parameter spaces of such actions.
status_evidence.claim: The topic remains an active area of research, with no complete answer to the value set and dimension bounds.
